statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id' | cut -c1-8); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir"); cd "$current_dir" 2>/dev/null && git_branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git') && git_status=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ' || echo '0') && git_dirty=$([ "$git_status" != "0" ] && echo '*' || echo '') && printf "\033[2m%s\033[0m \033[36m%s\033[0m \033[33m[%s]\033[0m \033[32m%s%s\033[0m \033[35m#%s\033[0m" "$model" "$dir_name" "$git_branch" "$git_status" "$git_dirty" "$session"
